Summary: Review rating rejections – analysis (May to Oct 2026 payout files)
Chennai + ROTN rejected with a reason (Jun-Oct)

1. Biggest reason (all branches): the Order ID typed in the form does not match the bill copy – 30.5% of all rejections (5,482). 61% of these had a correctly formatted Flipkart ID that simply did not match, and 25% were Amazon IDs with an extra '-1' at the end.

2. Next: rating screenshot missing or only the 'Thank you' symbol (18.8%), and bill copy missing with only the rating screenshot (16.8%). Together the three top reasons are about 66% of rejections – all are proof-upload mistakes that can be fixed at submission.
3. In Chennai + ROTN the order is different: delivery rating (26.6%) and seller rating (10.2%) lead – customers rate delivery or the seller instead of the product, mostly on Amazon.
4. 'Installation ticket not registered in CRM' is not the technician's fault: 1,257 tickets, 98% of the platform-split ones are Amazon.
5. Amazon orders are rejected much more than Flipkart (45.5% vs 23.1%, Jul-Oct).
6. October jumped to 14,024 submissions; 'rating screenshot missing / thank-you' rose from about 240-780 a month to 1,558.
7. Chennai + ROTN rejection rate was 41.7% in Oct and 42.7% in Sep, in line with the national rate (43.3% Oct).
Note: the reason groups are my grouping of the free-text reasons written by the auditors; May has no reason column.

How to stop it next time
Order ID typed in the form differs from the bill copy
Order ID in the form does not match the order ID printed on the bill copy (order details page).

Never type the Order ID: copy it from the order details screen and paste it. Take the bill/order screenshot first, then read the ID from it. Amazon IDs are 3-7-7 digits (e.g. 403-1234567-1234567): do not add an extra '-1' at the end. Flipkart IDs are OD + 18 digits. Add a format check and a 'type the Order ID again' confirm box to the form.
Rating screenshot missing / only 'thank you' symbol sent
Bill copy is there, but the rating screenshot is missing or only the 'Thank you' symbol / confirmation page was uploaded.
Upload the page that shows the stars (4 or 5) and the written review, not the 'Thank you' page. Show a sample picture under the upload box. The SA must check the picture before pressing Submit.
Bill copy (order invoice) missing - only rating screenshot sent
The order / invoice screen was not uploaded, only the rating screenshot (often the same picture uploaded in both boxes).

Label the two boxes clearly: 1 = Order details page (Order ID + product name), 2 = Rating and review page. Show a sample of each. Add a checklist in the morning meeting: two different pictures, two different screens.
Delivery rating given (not product rating)
Customer rated the delivery experience, not the product.

Tell the customer to open the product page and tap 'Write a product review' / 'Rate this product', not the delivery or seller question. Show the rating screen to the customer before they submit. Mostly an Amazon issue (1,118 of 1,222).
Installation ticket not registered by e-commerce team in CRM
The installation call was never created in CRM by the e-commerce team, so the ticket cannot be matched.

Not the SA's mistake. Check every e-commerce order in CRM the day before the visit, and send missing tickets to the e-commerce team the same day. Branch to keep a daily list of 'order seen but no ticket' and escalate. Almost all are Amazon orders (775 of 789).
Seller rating given (not product rating)
Customer rated the seller instead of the product.
Same guidance as delivery rating: ask the customer to rate the product itself, then take the screenshot of that review page.
Bill copy not clear
The order / bill screenshot is blurred, cropped or unreadable.
Use the phone's screenshot button instead of taking a photo of the screen. Make sure the Order ID and product name are fully visible, and re-upload if not.
Installation ticket registered in an earlier month (outside programme month)
Ticket was registered in an earlier month (March / April etc.), outside the month being paid.
Submit reviews in the month the ticket is registered and closed. Branch to give franchises a month-end cut-off reminder and a list of older open tickets.
Service rating given instead of product rating
Customer gave a service rating, not a product rating.
Ask the customer to review the product, and give the service feedback separately in the IFB app / call.
Both bill copy and rating screenshot missing
Neither the order page nor the rating page was uploaded.
Make both upload boxes mandatory with a minimum file size, and check pictures before submission.
Other
Service ticket updated instead of installation ticket
The SA closed a service ticket, not the installation ticket.
Close the correct installation ticket in CRM before submitting the review.
Other
Wrong platform / other product screenshot
Screenshot belongs to the other platform or another product.
Pick the platform first on the form and show a platform-wise sample screenshot.
